info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Collateral Administration By Collection Id-spec
info.description: The Collateral Administration Retrieval API enables users to access details about collateral administration associated with a specific collection identified by its unique ID. This API is critical for financial institutions and service providers who need to retrieve pertinent collateral information efficiently. Typical consumers include banking professionals, risk assessors, and analytics teams looking to analyze collateral assets. By providing insights into collateral holdings, this API supports decision-making processes and aids regulatory compliance.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific collateral collection identified by its unique ID. Use this to access information related to collections, ensuring you provide the correct resource identifier.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding the collections of collateral administration for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the required structure is adhered to in the provided JSON to accurately fetch the desired data.

GetCollateralAdministrationByCollectionI.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on collections in the collateral administration service. It specifies the format of the request body in JSON.

GetCollateralAdministrationByCollectionI.title: Collateral Administration Response

partyId.description: Unique identifier for the party associated with the collateral.

valuationDate.description: Date when the collateral was valued in ISO 8601 format.

securedExposureId.description: Unique identifier for the secured exposure related to the collateral.

haircutPercent.description: Percentage haircut applied to the collateral.

lienStatus.description: Current lien status of the collateral.

recordStatus.description: Status of the record in the system.

version.description: Version number of the collateral record.

updatedAt.description: Date when the collateral record was last updated in ISO 8601 format.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the collateral response.
